name: Do I need to move everything out before ceiling painters start?
description: You do not always have to empty the room, but moving small items out helps. Furniture, floors, and fixtures should be fully protected either way.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to move everything out before ceiling painters start?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes—if the room is already furnished, painters usually need to **cover furniture, floors, and fixtures** carefully. In many cases, moving smaller items out of the room helps the job go faster and reduces the chance of drips or overspray.
acceptedAnswer.description: You do not always have to empty the room, but moving small items out helps. Furniture, floors, and fixtures should be fully protected either way.
